metadata.question: Did the mean tropospheric nitrogen dioxide levels in Beijing all decrease during February 10-25, 2020 compared to January 1-20, 2020?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Collection: Primary COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2; fallback COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI/L3_NO2.
- Dates: Period 1 = 2020-01-01..2020-01-20; Period 2 = 2020-02-10..2020-02-25.
- Location: Beijing administrative boundary from FAO/GAUL/2015 level1 (fallback: 50 km buffer around 39.9042N, 116.4074E).

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Use QA filter: qa_value >= 0.75 to keep valid NO2 pixels (S5P quality mask). No separate cloud mask needed.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- Check image collection sizes; if both OFFL and NRTI are empty for a period -> C1.
- Compute valid pixel-days (sum of per-pixel counts after QA). If zero for period -> C2.
- Compute mean as (sum of NO2 over region and time) / (valid pixel-days). If null/NaN -> C3.
- Compare means: if Period 2 mean < Period 1 mean -> A, else B.
</thinking>

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); // You must include this line

async function runAnalysis() {
  function getInfoAsync(obj) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      obj.getInfo(resolve, reject);
    });
  }

  const scale = 5000;

  // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
  const p1Start = '2020-01-01';
  const p1End = '2020-01-21';   // inclusive of Jan 20
  const p2Start = '2020-02-10';
  const p2End = '2020-02-26';   // inclusive of Feb 25

  let geomSource = 'GAUL Beijing';
  let region = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level1')
                  .filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'China'))
                  .filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM1_NAME', 'Beijing'));
  let rSize = await getInfoAsync(region.size());
  if (!rSize || rSize === 0) {
    // Fallback to buffered point if GAUL lookup fails
    geomSource = 'Point buffer 50km';
    const beijingPt = ee.Geometry.Point([116.4074, 39.9042]);
    region = beijingPt.buffer(50000).bounds();
  } else {
    region = region.geometry();
  }

  // Helper to get S5P collection with fallback
  async function getS5PCollection(start, end, geom) {
    let col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2')
      .filterDate(start, end)
      .filterBounds(geom)
      .select(['tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density', 'qa_value']);
    let n = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
    if (n === 0) {
      let col2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI/L3_NO2')
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .filterBounds(geom)
        .select(['tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density', 'qa_value']);
      let n2 = await getInfoAsync(col2.size());
      if (n2 === 0) {
        return { empty: true, size: 0, col: null, src: 'None' };
      }
      return { empty: false, size: n2, col: col2, src: 'NRTI' };
    }
    return { empty: false, size: n, col: col, src: 'OFFL' };
  }

  // Processing for a period: QA mask, compute valid pixel-days and mean
  async function analyzePeriod(start, end, geom) {
    const found = await getS5PCollection(start, end, geom);
    if (found.empty) return { empty: true, src: 'None', nImages: 0 };

    const col = found.col;
    const nImages = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
    const masked = col.map(function(img) {
      const qa = img.select('qa_value');
      const valid = qa.gte(0.75);
      return img.updateMask(valid)
                .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density');
    });

    const cntImg = masked.count().rename('cnt');
    const sumImg = masked.sum().rename('sum');

    // Total possible pixel-days (approx): pixelCount * nImages
    const ones = ee.Image.constant(1);
    const pixelCount = await getInfoAsync(
      ones.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('constant')
    );

    const validPixDays = await getInfoAsync(
      cntImg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('cnt')
    );

    const totalSum = await getInfoAsync(
      sumImg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('sum')
    );

    const totalPossible = (pixelCount || 0) * (nImages || 0);
    const coveragePct = (validPixDays && totalPossible > 0) ? (100.0 * validPixDays / totalPossible) : 0.0;

    let meanVal = null;
    if (validPixDays && validPixDays > 0 && totalSum !== null && totalSum !== undefined) {
      meanVal = totalSum / validPixDays; // mean over all valid pixel-days
    }

    return {
      empty: false,
      src: found.src,
      nImages: nImages || 0,
      validPixDays: validPixDays || 0,
      coveragePct: coveragePct,
      mean: meanVal
    };
  }

  try {
    console.log(`Geom: ${geomSource}`);

    const p1 = await analyzePeriod(p1Start, p1End, region);
    const p2 = await analyzePeriod(p2Start, p2End, region);

    // Case handling
    if (p1.empty || p2.empty) {
      console.log(`P1 ${p1Start}..${p1End} | src=${p1.src} | imgs=${p1.nImages}`);
      console.log(`P2 ${p2Start}..${p2End} | src=${p2.src} | imgs=${p2.nImages}`);
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // Valid pixel checks
    if (!p1.validPixDays || p1.validPixDays === 0 || !p2.validPixDays || p2.validPixDays === 0) {
      console.log(`P1 ${p1Start}..${p1End} | src=${p1.src} | imgs=${p1.nImages} | vPixDays=${p1.validPixDays || 0}`);
      console.log(`P2 ${p2Start}..${p2End} | src=${p2.src} | imgs=${p2.nImages} | vPixDays=${p2.validPixDays || 0}`);
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // Calculation failure check
    const bad1 = (p1.mean === null || isNaN(p1.mean));
    const bad2 = (p2.mean === null || isNaN(p2.mean));
    if (bad1 || bad2) {
      console.log(`P1 mean valid: ${!bad1}, P2 mean valid: ${!bad2}`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // Print concise stats
    const fmt = (x) => (x === null || x === undefined) ? 'null' : Number(x).toExponential(3);
    console.log(`P1 ${p1Start}..${p1End} | src=${p1.src} | imgs=${p1.nImages} | vPixDays=${Math.round(p1.validPixDays)} | cover=${p1.coveragePct.toFixed(1)}% | mean=${fmt(p1.mean)} mol/m^2`);
    console.log(`P2 ${p2Start}..${p2End} | src=${p2.src} | imgs=${p2.nImages} | vPixDays=${Math.round(p2.validPixDays)} | cover=${p2.coveragePct.toFixed(1)}% | mean=${fmt(p2.mean)} mol/m^2`);

    // Final decision: Did mean NO2 decrease in P2 vs P1?
    const decreased = p2.mean < p1.mean;
    console.log(decreased ? 'A' : 'B');
  } catch (err) {
    // Any runtime issues
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
